summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed Form 6-K to disclose the sterling equivalent of its final dividend for the year ended December 31, 2025. The dividend of 24.1 US cents per ordinary share will be paid on May 27, 2026 to holders of record as of March 27, 2026. UK-address shareholders electing sterling dividends will receive 17.78 pence per share. This is a routine dividend announcement, not a special situation; it provides no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change. No deal terms, premium, or board action beyond standard dividend declaration is present.
